commander_identity.primary: Pirate reanimator: fill the graveyard with high-impact Pirates (ETB mill, Entomb, Buried Alive, looting), return one each beginning of combat as a hasty 4/4 with a finality counter, and attack with ETB/attack value.
commander_identity.secondary: Tribal mass reanimation (Living Death, Patriarch's Bidding, Victimize) as recovery and finish; finality-counter removal (Power Conduit) to make reanimation repeatable.

role.advances_plan: Brass's combat trigger is a free Pirate reanimation every turn; the self-mill and Pirate-ETB choices exist for it.
role.honest_note: Finality counters exile the returned Pirate when it would die, so each card is usually a one-shot unless Power Conduit removes the counter; the engine slowly consumes the graveyard.
